compatibilityDifferences: FastGPT stores quote q/a in search results and slims chat history metadata; the project's Citation GET currently exposes traceable source metadata but not quote text, so Chat context recovery is a product acceptance extension to verify.
FastGPT callers use datasetIds; this project intentionally exposes knowledgeSpaceId(s) and must not add datasetIds aliases.
FastGPT Agent tool input is primarily query-only while the project public schema explicitly validates filters, budget and Space scope.
